description: This file contains a unit test class for checking CI environment variables in the PyTorch project, specifically designed as a sanity check to ensure CI setup failures trigger reruns correctly.

classes.name: TestCISanityCheck
classes.description: A test class inheriting from unittest.TestCase that verifies the presence of CI environment variables, designed to fail intentionally to test CI rerun triggers.

methods.name: test_env_vars_exist(self)
methods.description: Checks that the 'CI' environment variable is not set, which is expected to fail, thereby testing the CI rerun mechanism.

methods.name: test_env_vars_exist_slow(self)
methods.description: A slower version of the environment variable check, testing the same condition with a different test decorator.
